abilities.name: Bulletproof
abilities.effect: Protects against bullet, ball, and bomb-based moves.
abilities.flavor_text: Protects the Pokémon from ball and bomb moves.

abilities.name: Soundproof
abilities.effect: Protects against sound-based moves.
abilities.flavor_text: Soundproofing gives the Pokémon full immunity to all sound-based moves.

abilities.name: Overcoat
abilities.effect: Protects against damage from weather.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon takes no damage from sandstorms. It is also protected from the effects of powders and spores.

abilities.name: Natural Cure
abilities.effect: Cures any major status ailment upon switching out.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon's status conditions are cured when it switches out.

abilities.name: Serene Grace
abilities.effect: Doubles the chance of moves' extra effects occurring.
abilities.flavor_text: Raises the likelihood of additional effects occurring when the Pokémon uses its moves.

abilities.name: Friend Guard
abilities.effect: Decreases all direct damage taken by friendly Pokémon to 0.75×.
abilities.flavor_text: Reduces damage dealt to allies.

abilities.name: Thick Fat
abilities.effect: Halves damage from Fire and Ice moves.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon is protected by a layer of thick fat, which halves the damage taken from Fire- and Ice-type moves.

abilities.name: Guts
abilities.effect: Increases Attack to 1.5× with a major status ailment.
abilities.flavor_text: It's so gutsy that having a status condition boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat.

abilities.name: Sheer Force
abilities.effect: Strengthens moves with extra effects to 1.3× their power, but prevents their extra effects.
abilities.flavor_text: Removes any additional effects from the Pokémon's moves, but increases the moves' power.

abilities.name: Healer
abilities.effect: Has a 30% chance of curing each adjacent ally of any major status ailment after each turn.
abilities.flavor_text: Sometimes cures the status conditions of the Pokémon's allies.

abilities.name: Anticipation
abilities.effect: Notifies all trainers upon entering battle if an opponent has a super-effective move, Self-Destruct, Explosion, or a one-hit KO move.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon can sense an opposing Pokémon's dangerous moves.

abilities.name: Magic Bounce
abilities.effect: Reflects most non-damaging moves back at their user.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon reflects status moves instead of getting hit by them.

abilities.name: Gluttony
abilities.effect: Makes the Pokémon eat any held Berry triggered by low HP below 1/2 its max HP.
abilities.flavor_text: If the Pokémon is holding a Berry to be eaten when its HP is low, it will instead eat the Berry when its HP drops to half or less.

abilities.name: Flash Fire

abilities.name: Flame Body

abilities.effect: Increases Special Attack to 1.5× but costs 1/8 max HP after each turn during strong sunlight.
abilities.flavor_text: In harsh sunlight, the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat is boosted, but its HP decreases every turn.

abilities.name: Early Bird
abilities.effect: Makes sleep pass twice as quickly.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon awakens from sleep twice as fast as other Pokémon.

abilities.name: Flash Fire
abilities.effect: Protects against Fire moves.  Once one has been blocked, the Pokémon's own Fire moves inflict 1.5× damage until it leaves battle.
abilities.flavor_text: If hit by a Fire-type move, the Pokémon absorbs the flames and uses them to power up its own Fire-type moves.

abilities.name: Unnerve
abilities.effect: Prevents opposing Pokémon from eating held Berries.
abilities.flavor_text: Unnerves opposing Pokémon and makes them unable to eat Berries.

abilities.name: Sand Rush
abilities.effect: Doubles Speed during a sandstorm.  Protects against sandstorm damage.
abilities.flavor_text: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in a sandstorm.

abilities.name: Fluffy
abilities.effect: Damage from contact moves is halved.  Damage from Fire moves is doubled.
abilities.flavor_text: Halves the damage taken from moves that make direct contact, but doubles that of Fire-type moves.

abilities.name: Swift Swim
abilities.effect: Doubles Speed during rain.
abilities.flavor_text: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in rain.

abilities.name: Water Veil
abilities.effect: Prevents burns.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon's water veil prevents it from being burned.

abilities.name: Supersweet Syrup
abilities.effect: Once per battle, when a Pokémon with Supersweet Syrup enters the battle, it lowers the evasion stat of all adjacent opponents by one stage.
abilities.flavor_text: Lowers the evasion of opposing Pokémon by 1 stage when first sent into battle

abilities.name: Regenerator
abilities.effect: Heals for 1/3 max HP upon switching out.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon has a little of its HP restored when withdrawn from battle.

abilities.name: Sticky Hold
abilities.effect: Prevents a held item from being removed by other Pokémon.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon's held items cling to its sticky body and cannot be removed by other Pokémon.

abilities.name: Levitate
abilities.effect: Evades Ground moves.
abilities.flavor_text: By floating in the air, the Pokémon receives full immunity to all Ground-type moves.

abilities.name: Insomnia
abilities.effect: Prevents sleep.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon's insomnia prevents it from falling asleep.

abilities.name: Forewarn
abilities.effect: Reveals the opponents' strongest move upon entering battle.
abilities.flavor_text: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon can tell one of the moves an opposing Pokémon has.

abilities.name: Inner Focus
abilities.effect: Prevents flinching.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon's intense focus prevents it from flinching or being affected by Intimidate.
